roots.title: Convex Programming
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Convex Programming; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

knowledge_statements.scope_note: Subgradient multiplier characterization for a convex extended-real objective restricted to an affine set.
knowledge_statements.statement_latex:
Let $A\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}$, $b\in\mathbb R^m$, $Q:=\{x\in\mathbb R^n:Ax=b\}$, and let $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R\cup\{+\infty\}$ be convex. Define $X^*:=\arg\min\{f(x):x\in Q\}$. If $x^*\in Q$ and $f(x^*)<+\infty$, then
\[
x^*\in X^*\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \exists g^*\in\partial f(x^*),\ \exists y^*\in\mathbb R^m\ \text{such that}\ g^*=A^Ty^*.
\]
knowledge_statements.statement_plain: For a finite-valued feasible point in a convex problem with affine equality constraints, global optimality is equivalent to the existence of a subgradient lying in the range of the transpose of the constraint matrix.
knowledge_statements.conclusion_latex: x^*\in X^*\iff \exists g^*\in\partial f(x^*),\ \exists y^*\in\mathbb R^m:\ g^*=A^Ty^*
